## What's new

- Rebuilt the frontend with React while preserving native terminal tabs and PTY integration.
- Added a searchable in-app folder picker for new tabs and startup sessions, with folder navigation and a native Browse option.
- Added configurable startup sessions: choose folders, reorder, enable, disable, or remove them. Only enabled sessions open on launch.
- Moved Settings into a modal. Both Settings and the folder picker close with Escape or a click outside.
- Polished the interface with rounded tab corners, Lucide icons, and a compact Add session button.
- Improved terminal cleanup when closing tabs, refreshing the app, and updating React components.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mikecao/partty/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0
